user.title: April Brother nRF52832 scanner
user.description: Choose the gateway whose nRF52832 radio should become its own, listen-only Bluetooth scanner. The gateway must run the ab-ble-gateway-v4 firmware.

abort.no_gateway: No loaded ESPHome gateway exposes the nRF52832 serial proxy (port "Nordic scanner"). Install the ab-ble-gateway-v4 firmware first.
abort.already_configured: This gateway's nRF52832 scanner is already configured.
